A '''storage and transceiving droid'''<ref name="I2-CG">{{CSWECite|II|73|I2-CG}}</ref> was a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] used to both receive and store information.<ref name="Operation: Recovery">{{WEGCite|story=Operation: Recovery|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide}}</ref> [[I2-CG droid/Legends|I2-CG]] was the designation of a series of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] storage and transceiving droids based on the [[ED4]] model manufactured by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]].<ref name="I2-CG" />
